title: Controlled vs uncontrolled inputs
objective: Distinguish a React-controlled input from an uncontrolled field registered with React Hook Form, and keep a single source of truth.
predict: Typing into a value-bound field without an onChange handler will not update it; registration with RHF avoids duplicating React state.
expectedBehavior: Type `Practice HTTP` using the keyboard and submit; the output must reflect the text. Submitting an empty or two-character title must not update the output.
commonFailure: The title is hard-coded and never updated by the registered field.
securityBoundary: The browser must validate for usability, but the HTTP server still checks the 3–100 character title and allowed priorities.
